master.title: The free banking myth
master.post_text:
Free banking in Spain mostly belongs to mortgage customers. Everyone else pays, one condition at a time, and foreign owners are usually in the everyone else column.

The game works like this. Take a loan from a Spanish bank and you'll often get free banking bundled in. No loan? Then free usually means conditional: you buy the bank's products and push a minimum transaction volume through the account every month, and the moment you miss the conditions, the fees start.

Why does that matter for foreign owners specifically? Because 60 to 70 percent of foreigners who buy property in Spain never take a Spanish loan. The free-banking route was never built for you.

translations.title: Myten om gratis bank i Spania
translations.post_text:
Gratis bank i Spania er stort sett forbeholdt lånekunder. Alle andre betaler, ett vilkår om gangen, og utenlandske boligeiere havner som regel i kolonnen for alle andre.

Spillet fungerer slik. Tar du et lån i en spansk bank, får du ofte gratis banktjenester med på kjøpet. Ikke noe lån? Da betyr gratis som regel betinget: du kjøper bankens produkter og sender et minstevolum av transaksjoner gjennom kontoen hver måned, og i det øyeblikket du bommer på vilkårene, starter gebyrene.
